title: European Accessibility Act transitional period for existing products ends
detail: Directive (EU) 2019/882 gives service providers a transitional period ending 28 June 2030, during which they may keep providing services using products that were lawfully in use before 28 June 2025; service contracts agreed before 28 June 2025 may also run on for no more than five years. After this date those legacy products and contracts must meet the Act's accessibility requirements, for which EN 301 549 provides the technical means of conformance.

title: Conflicting national standards to EN 301 549 V4.1.1 withdrawn (dow)
detail: National standards that conflict with EN 301 549 V4.1.1 — including national editions of the older V3.2.1 — must be withdrawn by this date. After it, V4.1.1 (WCAG 2.2 AA based, with Annex ZA for the Web Accessibility Directive and Annex ZB for the European Accessibility Act) is the only national version of the standard in force.

title: EN 301 549 V4.1.1 national adoption deadline (dop/e)
detail: By this date the national standards bodies of CEN/CENELEC/ETSI members must publish EN 301 549 V4.1.1 as an identical national standard or endorse it. The date is fixed in the published standard, which also records its adoption on 24 August 2026 and a national announcement deadline (doa) of 30 November 2026.

title: EN 301 549 V4.1.1 expected to be cited in the EU Official Journal
detail: Once cited in the Official Journal, V4.1.1 becomes the harmonised standard carrying presumption of conformity under the EAA, superseding V3.2.1. Expected around October 2026 — this date is a forecast, not confirmed; check the Official Journal directly before relying on it.

title: EN 301 549 V4.1.1 published
detail: Finalised version of EN 301 549, moving Clauses 9–11 to WCAG 2.2 AA. Not yet a cited harmonised standard under the EAA — see the expected Official Journal citation below. V3.2.1 (WCAG 2.1 AA) remains the version with legal effect until then.

title: EN 301 549 V4.1.0 published as draft for public enquiry
detail: Draft version updating Clauses 9–11 (web, non-web documents, software) to align with WCAG 2.2 AA (W3C Recommendation, December 2024), released for ETSI's public enquiry and vote ahead of finalisation.

title: European Accessibility Act: compliance deadline for businesses
detail: In-scope products and services placed on the EU market must meet EAA accessibility requirements from this date.

title: European Accessibility Act: member state transposition deadline
detail: EU member states must have adopted and published the laws, regulations and administrative provisions needed to comply with the EAA.

title: Web Accessibility Directive: monitoring and reporting begins
detail: Member states must have monitoring methodologies in place and begin publishing accessibility monitoring reports.

title: EN 301 549 V3.2.1 cited in the EU Official Journal
detail: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1339 (adopted 11 August 2021, published in OJ L 289 on 12 August 2021) cites V3.2.1 as the harmonised standard under the Web Accessibility Directive, giving it a presumption of conformity — the version still in legal effect today.

title: Web Accessibility Directive: mobile apps must conform
detail: All public sector mobile apps must meet WCAG 2.1 AA.

title: EN 301 549 V3.2.1 published
detail: Refines WCAG 2.1 AA alignment across web, software and hardware clauses. Became the version in legal effect once cited in the Official Journal a few months later (see below).

title: Web Accessibility Directive: existing public sector websites must conform
detail: All existing public sector websites must meet WCAG 2.1 AA.

title: EN 301 549 V3.1.1 published
detail: Updated edition of EN 301 549, continuing WCAG 2.1 alignment.

title: Web Accessibility Directive: new public sector websites must conform
detail: All new public sector websites (published on or after 23 September 2018) must meet WCAG 2.1 AA.

title: European Accessibility Act adopted
detail: Directive (EU) 2019/882 on the accessibility requirements for products and services is formally adopted.

title: Web Accessibility Directive: member state transposition deadline
detail: EU member states are required to have transposed the Web Accessibility Directive into national law.

title: EN 301 549 V2.1.2 published
detail: First version of EN 301 549 to align its web content requirements with WCAG 2.1.

title: Web Accessibility Directive enters into force
detail: Directive (EU) 2016/2102, requiring accessible websites and mobile apps for public sector bodies, enters into force.
